notes: WArmy 0.4.60 — Reading and steering replies got smoother. Clicking the horse-head before a final reply opens it in the nm viewer as a clean read-only page (rendered Markdown, no editor column), saved as a .nm file the viewer recognizes automatically; click the horse-head again to close that viewer. Buttons inside generated interactive replies now work in the nm viewer instead of failing with a sender error. Regenerate text and regenerate interactive from the horse-head right-click menu now succeed reliably. In evolution mode your own messages show the same hover toolbar (time, read-aloud, quote, copy), boosted replies render their interactive content inline, and closing evolution while branches are still unselected prompts you to pick a branch first.
